host_reasoning_effort: inherited runtime default; not explicitly overridden
backend: Codex collaboration subagents; not standalone API
budget_rule: Each host question and final attempt counts once; incorrect/incomplete final attempts continue with verdict no only.
grading: Frozen six-element rubric; full narrative, strict hand/arm. Controller grading, not independent blinded model.
isolation: Fresh fork_turns=none agents; solver prohibited tools by instruction, not OS isolation
host_prompt_delivery: Frozen text read by agent; surrounding Codex runtime instructions still apply
timestamp_note: Event times are controller recording times, not inference start/end timestamps.

Submission slots used: {s}/50. The game continues. Return only your next question JSON or another final explanation JSON. No tools; no hints are supplied.
